what_happened: Job e5sg was at the reading stage. Its reader produced no reading, and two queue drains (drain-24 and drain-25) both stopped on it. Drain gave no message saying why. The the person running Athena read the job by hand with `athena correct`, which let the drain continue. The the person running Athena queued the underlying cause as a separate fix. No acceptance criteria or checks were evaluated, because the job never got a reading.
cause: A reader stage that returns nothing is not treated as a recorded, diagnosable failure. Drain halts on the item, and the reason (reader error, timeout, empty output, refusal) is not written to the drain output or the job record. A halted drain also has no quarantine or skip path for one item and no bounded retry, so a second drain hits the same stop. The the person running Athena has to find the cause by hand, and the only way to unblock the queue is to bypass the reader.
prevention: When the reader ends with no reading, Athena would record a typed failure on the job. It would hold only that job and continue draining the other items. The failure would carry the reason: the reader's exit status, any error text, and whether it timed out or produced empty output. Drain output and `athena status` would show the held job with this reason. A test would run the reader stage with a fake reader that returns nothing. It would assert that a reason is recorded, the drain moves past the item, and the job can be retried or corrected.
proposed_request: When a queued job's reader stage ends with no reading, Athena should record the reason on the job and hold only that job, and queue drain should carry on with the remaining items instead of stopping. Acceptance: (1) a job whose reader returns nothing gets a recorded failure reason (reader exit status, error text, and whether it timed out or came back empty), and that reason appears in the drain output and in the job's status. (2) Drain skips the held job and processes the other queued items; it does not stop. (3) The held job can be retried or fixed with `athena correct` without hand-editing state. (4) A test uses a fake reader that returns nothing and shows all three behaviors. (5) Also find why job 20261029-233021-e5sg got no reading from the reader, and report the cause in the job's summary.
